newsitem.title: USA: US banking bill discussions continue - Rep. Leach.
newsitem.headline: US banking bill discussions continue - Rep. Leach.

text.p: U.S. House Banking Committee Chairman James Leach, R-Iowa, said Wednesday Republicans are discussing the prospects of attaching banking legislation to a short-term spending bill.
"We have under active consideration ... the prospect of bringing an omnibus banking bill up within the context of a continuing resolution," Leach told reporters outside a hearing.
Asked when that might occur, he replied: "presumably by the end of next week these things will be concluded."
Leach said proposals to bolster the undercapitalized fund that insures deposits at thrifts and proposals for regulatory relief were "central to discussions."

The House Banking Committee has also been in discussions with the Senate Banking Committee on banking legislation, he said. "Our committees are engaged in constructive dialogue to bring to fruition the banking agenda," Leach said.
